Story of Haridas -Tansen
• Discover the Profound Teachings of the Upanishads! **
• Available in Multiple Languages!**
Kannada | Tamil | Telugu | Malayalam | Hindi
• How to Change the Language?**
Simply go to the settings menu and select your preferred audio track!
The **Upanishad Ganga episode "The Yoga of Action: Haridas-Tansen Guru"** offers key insights into the spiritual and philosophical concepts of karma yoga (the yoga of action), intertwined with the journey of Tansen, one of the greatest musicians in Indian history, and his guru, Swami Haridas.
